images.location: 新原海灘（Mibaru Beach / Miibaru Beach），南城市，沖繩縣，日本
images.caption_zh: 南城市新原海灘的沙灘、海岸岩石與玻璃船（2009 年 9 月 25 日攝影）。
images.alt_zh: 南城市新原海灘的淺色沙灘與碧藍海面，岸邊有玻璃船及覆有綠色植物的大型海岸岩石
images.changes: From the photographer's publicly listed Flickr 2048px image; EXIF orientation normalized; resized with Lanczos and converted to WebP. No crop, generative changes, or upscaling.
images.crop_advice: For a 16:9 crop, object-position: 50% 65% reduces the large sky area while retaining the sand, boat and recognizable coastal rock. Keep both the rock and beach visible.
images.currentness_note: Historical 2009 beach photograph. The owner's public description says Mibaru Beach and tags include nanjocity/mibarubeach. It is not a record of present-day boat operations, operators, schedules, or facilities. The approximate embedded map point is not used as a precise camera-location claim.
